body.statement: What is the exact minimax expected-length frontier for replacement-private, uniformly honest intervals for \(\tau_Q^{\mathrm c}(x_0)\) over \(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{full}}\)? In particular, can the positive-density confidence-modulus handle reduce the higher-order release sensitivity while retaining the uniform bias guarantee, or can it certify that an additional nuisance-driven privacy term is unavoidable?
body.justification: The gap between the ordinary full-class lower bound and the constructive higher-order upper phase is the genuine unresolved mathematical content.
body.gap: Neither KennedyBalakrishnanRobinsWasserman2024 nor the located private CATE and private confidence-interval papers characterize this privacy-constrained confidence modulus.
body.consumer: A resolution determines whether private heterogeneous-treatment-effect studies pay only the ordinary local-regression privacy price or an irreducible higher-order nuisance price.

obligation.what_is_open: Determine whether a paired-microcell fuzzy family admits an \(n\)-sample coupling with sufficiently small expected Hamming cost, and construct a fully specified private stabilized higher-order estimator over the full unknown-density class.
obligation.obstruction: The one-cell identity cancels the one-observation prior mixture but does not control dependencies caused by repeat visits to a latent microcell.  On the upper side, no explicit private Gram/PTR construction is present and the current learner uses known uniform design only.
obligation.attempted: I proved the general approximate-DP Hamming-transport inequality, embedded a strictly positive common-support ordinary bump submodel, audited the paired-cell cancellation, and optimized every frozen envelope.  The missing coupling cost and private full-class Gram analysis are precisely the two steps needed to decide the \(q\)-branch.
obligation.partial_result:
The proved ordinary two-law submodel yields the corrected full-class lower bound
\[
 n^{-\gamma/(2\gamma+d)}\vee
 \{1\wedge(n\epsilon_n)^{-\gamma/(\gamma+d)}\}.
\]
The constrained envelope optimization yields, only for the attainable uniform-design construction and subject to the unresolved remainder, the corrected upper phase
\[
 r_{\mathrm{np}}\vee r_{\mathrm{reg}}\vee
 N_{\mathrm{priv}}^{-1/(1+d/\gamma+d/\min\{q,\gamma\})}.
\]
The Hamming-transport lemma reduces any fuzzy paired-cell privacy lower bound to an explicit coupling-cost calculation.  The identity
\(uv+(1/4-u^2)t=0\) verifies a one-observation prior-mixture cancellation, but it does not by itself construct a coupling of the two \(n\)-sample mixture laws with the required expected Hamming cost; repeated observations from the same latent microcell create dependence.  Nor does the frozen learner specify a propose-test-release or private-Gram algorithm on the full, unknown-design-density class.  Consequently these results give an honest bracket but do not decide whether the nuisance-driven privacy term is minimax unavoidable.
